source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of AC through a resistor (PDF 92-94).

blocks.text: Resistor R AC source se jura hai (Fig 17.6 a). Lamhati voltage V = Vo sin(wt) (17.10) hai, aur current I = V/R = (Vo/R) sin(wt) = Io sin(wt) (17.11), jahan Io = Vo/R peak current hai. Voltage aur current dono sine functions hain jo aik hi waqt apni zyada aur kam qeematon se guzarte hain, is liye woh in phase hain (Fig 17.6 b). Phasor diagram mein vectors VR aur IR mutawazi banaye jate hain (Fig 17.6 c). Current ki mukhalfat resistance hai, R = V/I.

Zaya hone wali taqat current ke square ke mutanasib hai, is liye current musbat ho ya manfi, farq nahi parta. Lekin Io peak wala AC, Io qeemat ke DC jitni taqat zaya nahi karta, kyunke AC har aadhe chakkar mein sirf aik lamhe peak par hota hai. Lamhati taqat P = VI = I^2 R = V^2/R (17.12) hai. Aust taqat

= R, aur kyunke = Io^2/2 = Irms^2,

= Irms^2 R = Irms Vrms. Yeh formulas sirf tab durust hain jab V aur I in phase hon.

blocks.title: Aap ki maloomat ke liye
blocks.text: Bohat si video doorbells 12 V AC par chalti hain: kam voltage ka AC sambhalne mein zyada mehfooz hai aur bijli ke jhatke ka khatra kam karta hai.

1 kW heating element 250 V AC supply se jura hai. Supply se liya gaya current aur garam hone par element ki resistance maloom karein. Hal: P = VI, is liye I = P/V = 1000 W / 250 V = 4 A, aur R = V/I = 250 V / 4 A = 62.5 ohm.

blocks.prompt: Sirf resistance wale AC circuit mein V aur I ka phase farq kya hai?

items: Resistor: I = Io sin(wt), V ke saath in phase; R = V/I.
